note: Confirm A/B of the cause found in v025-slow-diag (Rodney 2026-11-04): ts3fixes PushHeld (UnseenViewers.cs) scans every Sim (Queries.GetObjects<Sim>) every 5 ticks since [UnseenAnim]/[UnseenTable] made ts3native accept the viewer channel, then BEGIN 12 is refused ([UnseenThrottle] off): ~50-60 ms/s wasted in TaskObjects. Fix arm = rel025d asi + release ini (rel025d-ini2) + ts3fixes rel025d-ph (BEGIN before the scan). Same settings as v025-speed-ab. Pass = it/s within ~5% of the v024 runs, both orders.
